result.summary: Found one minor content issue: the same restaurant appears twice side-by-side in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. Other potentially clipped items are horizontally-scrollable carousel edges or bottom-of-viewport cut-offs, which are excluded from reporting.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards next to each other with the same image, delivery time, and delivery fee, making the list look duplicated or broken.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate nearby restaurants in the carousel, or if they represent different branches, display distinguishing info such as branch name or address.
